items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021

ctx.x: Yeah absolutely. So I had a few more questions relating to Sun Ra and your experience working with him and the Arkestra. Did you ever have much interaction with June Tyson?
No, only to say hello. To me she was like a Goddess. Like a couple times when I was at Sun Ra’s place she was there too. And she was in garb. She was wearing you know some

kind of Egyptian headwear and like I saw her running around the house and she might have been doing mundane things to help out Sun Ra but she was still a Goddess so no I didn’t approach her. You know. No.
